ClientApplications.title: Manage your applications here
ClientApplications.subtitle: Create and track your visa applications here.

list.title: Your applications
list.subtitle: Filter by status and track your document progress.

errors.fetchBody: Something went wrong while loading this application. Please try again or return to your applications list.
errors.notFoundBody: We couldn’t find an application with ID {id}. It may not exist or you may not have access to it.

cta.confirmNewApplication: You already have an ongoing application. Are you sure you want to create a new one?

documents.requiredSubtitle: Upload the documents listed below. If a document needs to be replaced, we’ll explain why.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.message: Ready to begin your journey to South Africa? Create your first application now.

journey.title: Your visa application
journey.subtitle: Your consultant will share important updates here.

ClientApplications.noTimeline: Timeline will appear once your application is submitted.

statuses.not_started_desc: Your application is ready. Start by uploading the required documents below.
statuses.waiting_documents_desc: Please upload the required documents listed in Step 1.
statuses.documents_under_review_desc: Your documents were uploaded successfully and are being checked by your consultant.
statuses.documents_approved_desc: All required documents have been approved. Your consultant can now continue with your visa application.
statuses.documents_not_approved_desc: Please read the note beside any document marked as needing attention, then upload a replacement.
statuses.visa_journey_started_desc: Your consultant has submitted your visa application to the relevant department.
statuses.visa_issue_action_needed: Your consultant is following up on an issue
statuses.visa_issue_action_needed_desc: The department needs something further. Your consultant will explain the situation and coordinate any action with you directly.
statuses.visa_approved_desc: Congratulations! Your consultant will arrange delivery or share the official notice with you directly.
statuses.finished_desc: Your consultant has completed the final handover. Please contact them if you need any further help.
statuses.cancelled_desc: Your consultant will contact you to explain the outcome and discuss the way forward.

activeGuard.title: You already have an active application
activeGuard.body: You currently have an ongoing application. Creating a new one may delay processing and cause duplicate records. Do you want to continue?

wizard.documentsSubtitle: Upload each item below. Your consultant will review them and let you know if anything needs attention.
wizard.documentsNextAction: Please upload any documents still marked as outstanding. Once uploaded, they will be reviewed. If required to resubmit, please follow the consultants instructions as noted below the required file. Do not forget to click upload once a document has been selected.
wizard.documentsUnderReview: Your documents have been uploaded successfully and are now under review. You can check each document’s status below.
wizard.documentsNeedsAttention: One or more documents needs attention. Please read the note beside it and upload a replacement document. This step stays open until all required documents are approved.
wizard.journeySubtitle: We’ll keep you updated as your application moves through the department.
wizard.submittedBody: Your consultant has submitted your visa application to the relevant department. We’ll let you know when there is an update.
wizard.issueActionBody: The department has raised an issue that needs attention. Your consultant will explain what happens next and coordinate any action with you directly.
wizard.outcomeSubtitle: Your consultant will contact you about the result and any next steps.
wizard.outcomePending: Your application is still in progress
wizard.outcomePendingBody: There is no final decision recorded yet. Please check back here for updates from your consultant.
wizard.outcomeApproved: Congratulations! Your visa has been approved
wizard.outcomeApprovedBody: Your visa application journey was a success. Your consultant will be in contact with you shortly on the next steps.
wizard.outcomeDeclined: Your visa application was not approved
wizard.outcomeDeclinedBody: Unfortunately, the visa application was rejected. Your consultant will be in contact to discuss the way forward and, if needed, guide you through opening a new application.
wizard.outcomeCancelledBody: Your consultant will contact you to explain what this means and discuss the way forward.
